definitions.explanation: A room in a school or educational institution where classes are taught. The physical space where learning takes place.
Can also refer to a learning class or course, as in {料理|りょうり}{教室|きょうしつ} (cooking class) or {英語|えいご}{教室|きょうしつ} (English class).

notes:
{教室|きょうしつ} means classroom (a room for teaching) or a class/course/school.

FORMS:
{教|きょう} (teach) + {室|しつ} (room) = teaching room

SENSE 1 - CLASSROOM:
- {教室|きょうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the classroom
- {教室|きょうしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}する→掃除：02889_souji⟧: to clean the classroom
